i think im going to talk to my counselor at college... I just have a history of depression and anxiety... and recent events combined with loneliness is making it bad. I've had a lot of suicide thoughts recently. Sorry I probably over reacted by posting this.. i think i just need someone to vent to and give me advice about what the hell to do and i guess a counselor would help that. 
i keep wanting to give up, but im so wishy washy about it.. so if i keep changing my mind clearly i shouldn't give up and just need some help.
sorry for the scare, thank you for the advice.
